name: glitter-cloth
title: Glitter Cloth
description: An OGL shader surface with animated silk folds, glitter sparkle, and vignette depth shading.

usage.label: Astro
React
Svelte
usage.code:
<script>
  import "@/components/motion-kit/glitter-cloth-element.ts";
</script>

<motion-glitter-cloth
  color="#ff6900"
  speed={1}
  brightness={1}
  blend-strength={0.02}
  noise-scale={4}
  vignette-strength={15}
  vignette-power={0.25}
  vignette-opacity={1}
  class="w-full h-[500px]"
/>

usage.label: HTML
usage.code:
<script type="module" src="/components/motion-kit/glitter-cloth-element.js"></script>

<motion-glitter-cloth
  color="#ff6900"
  speed="1"
  brightness="1"
  blend-strength="0.02"
  noise-scale="4"
  vignette-strength="15"
  vignette-power="0.25"
  vignette-opacity="1"
  class="w-full h-[500px]"
/>

props.name: color
props.description: Primary color of the glitter cloth (accent and shadow colors are auto-derived).

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed of the cloth folds and sparkle.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Overall brightness multiplier of the fabric.

props.name: blend-strength
props.description: How strongly the noise blends with the base color (vividLight mode).

props.name: noise-scale
props.description: Scale of the noise texture (lower = larger grain).

props.name: vignette-strength
props.description: Intensity of the vignette darkening at edges.

props.name: vignette-power
props.description: Power curve of the vignette falloff.

props.name: vignette-opacity
props.description: Opacity of the vignette effect (0 = disabled).
